# Ridu 0.16.2

This patch lets `@riducms/sveltekit` run in SvelteKit 3 applications as well as SvelteKit 2.

## Fixes

- `@riducms/sveltekit` failed to type-check in a SvelteKit 3 application. It imported the `Handle`
  type from `@sveltejs/kit`, which SvelteKit 3 exports only from `@sveltejs/kit/hooks`, and read
  `browser` from `$app/environment`, which SvelteKit 3 deprecates and ships no types for.
  `createRiduHandle` now returns a `RiduHandle` that both versions accept as a `Handle`, so it
  still composes with `sequence`. The package reads the browser flag from `esm-env`, which
  `$app/environment` re-exports in SvelteKit 2. The peer range is now
  `^2.20.0 || ^3.0.0`.
- The SvelteKit guide shows how a SvelteKit 3 application declares the Ridu URL in `src/env.ts`,
  and where `sequence` and `Handle` come from.

## Upgrade

Update the Go module and all Ridu npm packages to 0.16.2 together and rebuild with the matching CLI.
This patch changes no Go APIs, manifest or protocol versions, plugin contracts, migration
planners, or database layouts. `@riducms/sveltekit` adds `esm-env` as a dependency. SvelteKit 2
applications need no changes.
